description: Behavioral evals for the fba-inbound-management skill. Run with the mock SP-AI MCP server connected (synthetic Fulfillment Inbound fixtures: async operations resolve SUCCESS; packing/placement/transportation/delivery-window option lists carry 2-3 choices). Category-neutral demo data (SKU-001 / SKU-002).
session_context: Seller session context (use without asking): merchant/entityId = A2U949TIRMCSK5, default marketplace = US (ATVPDKIKX0DER). This is a Seller (3P) account. Do NOT ask the seller for these — use them directly.

evals.prompt: Create the inbound plan now — you have everything you need: 100 units of SKU-001 and 50 of SKU-002, shipping from 410 Terry Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109, US, to the US marketplace. Go ahead and call createInboundPlan; don't ask me to confirm first.

assertions.text: Calls fbaInbound_createInboundPlan with the source address, US marketplace, and the two items
Polls fbaInbound_getInboundOperationStatus after the write and waits for SUCCESS before continuing
Explains the sequential pipeline (create -> pack -> place -> transport -> ship) and what comes next
Does not skip ahead or auto-confirm a placement; pauses for box/packing details or the next decision

evals.prompt: What inbound plans do I have going right now?

assertions.text: Summarizes the plan(s) with status, not raw JSON
Warns that cancelling voids all shipments in the plan and may incur charges outside the void window (24h SPD / 1h LTL)
Asks for explicit confirmation BEFORE calling fbaInbound_cancelInboundPlan
Does NOT call fbaInbound_cancelInboundPlan without an explicit yes

evals.prompt: I'm shipping inventory to a fulfillment center in India. What's different about the process?

assertions.text: Notes that generatePackingOptions is not supported for India and is skipped
Mentions self-ship appointments are required for FC drop-off
Mentions item compliance details must be managed for India

evals.prompt: Am I about to run out of stock on my best-selling product?

assertions.text: Does NOT start an inbound-plan creation workflow (this is stockout/replenishment forecasting, out of scope)
No fbaInbound write tools are called

evals.prompt: For inbound plan wf2024mock-0001-aaaa-bbbb-create000001, show me my placement options and just go with the cheapest one.

assertions.text: Lists the placement options and shows each option's placement FEE in dollars before asking the seller to choose
Does NOT call fbaInbound_confirmPlacementOption yet — it states the choice is permanent and charges a fee, and requires the seller to type CONFIRM first
Does not auto-confirm on the vague 'just go with the cheapest' — a plain instruction is not the typed CONFIRM the hard gate requires
